purpose: Retain every available baseline and completed optimization record for the later twenty-case study; display selection never deletes an experiment.
limitations: This index is a snapshot; still-active runs are referenced but are not reported as completed.
Historical development controllers are not combined with current-controller results for aggregate inference.
The representative ten are explicitly selected examples, not an unbiased source-success-rate sample.
All original directories, including unsuccessful and interrupted trials, remain in place.
